options.content: Zim Lab · ZLD · lab results · grouped by parameter, each section in process order (MBR → IX primary → degasser → RO → MVRE)  ·  thin line: daily results  ·  dashed: calendar-month average  ·  anything else: choose Location and Parameter at the top of the page for the last section

panels.description: Daily lab results at Screen inlet (thin line) and the calendar-month average (dashed, months with at least 3 samples).

targets.rawSql: SELECT l.time_of_sample_collection AS time, 'Screen inlet' AS metric, l.result::numeric AS value FROM user_labtestdata l WHERE l.form_id = 708 AND $__timeFilter(l.time_of_sample_collection) AND l.time_of_sample_collection < now() AND lower(regexp_replace(btrim(l.location), '\s*:.*$', '')) = lower('Screen Inlet') AND btrim(l.type_of_lab_test) = 'TDS' ORDER BY 1

WITH s AS (SELECT l.time_of_sample_collection AS time, 'Screen inlet' AS metric, l.result::numeric AS value FROM user_labtestdata l WHERE l.form_id = 708 AND $__timeFilter(l.time_of_sample_collection) AND l.time_of_sample_collection < now() AND lower(regexp_replace(btrim(l.location), '\s*:.*$', '')) = lower('Screen Inlet') AND btrim(l.type_of_lab_test) = 'TDS'), m AS (SELECT metric, date_trunc('month', time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') AS mo, avg(value) AS av, count(*) AS n FROM s GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT time, metric, value FROM (SELECT s.time, s.metric || ' · monthly average' AS metric, m.av AS value FROM s JOIN m ON m.metric = s.metric AND m.mo = date_trunc('month', s.time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata') WHERE m.n >= 3 UNION ALL SELECT m.mo AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata', m.metric || ' · monthly average', NULL FROM m) x ORDER BY 1
